metadata.title: Group Chat: Who Lied?
metadata.subtitle: A leaked voice transcript from our missing friend proves one of us was at the lake.

nodes.text: 10:14 PM · Group Chat 'LAKE HOUSE 5'. It's been 72 hours since Hannah vanished after the bonfire.
Guys tell me I'm not crazy—did Hannah's account just go online?!
Police have her phone, Chloe. Probably a cloud glitch.
Wait no... someone just dropped an audio file into the chat.
LEAKED VOICE TRANSCRIPT (Hannah · 11:51 PM Friday): 'Stop grabbing my arm! Why did you delete the lake photos—I'm telling Zoe everything!'
Hold on. You ALL told the police you left the dock at 11:30. That recording is from 11:51!
I WAS in my car by 11:30! Ask Devon, he saw my headlights!
Uh... Chloe, I didn't see your car leave. I was looking for my keys by the boathouse.

nodes.caption: Look at the metadata on the bonfire selfie. Someone edited the time.

nodes.prompt: One of your three friends is lying right now. Who do you press?

options.label: Press Chloe about her fake alibi
options.player_reply_text: Chloe, why did you claim Devon saw you leave when he didn't?

options.label: Isolate the background noise in audio
options.player_reply_text: Wait—turn up the audio. Hear that car chime in the background?

nodes.text: Because I went back for my jacket! And I saw LIAM's red Jeep still parked behind the trees!
SECRET UNLOCKED: Beneath Hannah's voice is a distinct triple-beep key fob—the exact custom alarm on Liam's red Jeep!
BRO THAT'S LIAM'S JEEP ALARM! Liam, you said you drove home at 11:20!!
SYSTEM ALERT: Liam has left the group chat 'LAKE HOUSE 5'.

nodes.headline: Liam Just Left The Group Chat...
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 2: A private DM from Liam reveals he wasn't the one who leaked the audio—Hannah is still online.

nodes.text: 10:22 PM · Two minutes after leaving the group, Liam sends you a private DM.
Zoe, don't trust Devon or Chloe. I left the group so they can't see this.
Why was your Jeep still at the lake at 11:51, Liam? Tell me the truth right now.
Because Devon borrowed my Jeep keys to 'grab blankets'! He brought them back soaked in lake water at midnight.
(Group Chat) Zoe?! Devon just deleted all his messages from Friday night!!

nodes.prompt: Devon is wiping his tracks right now. What do you do?

options.label: Expose Liam's Jeep alibi in the group
options.player_reply_text: Devon, why did you borrow Liam's Jeep at 11:45?!

options.label: Recover Hannah's shared cloud album
options.player_reply_text: Too late, Devon—I still have Hannah's shared album link.

nodes.text: Fine! Hannah found out who stole the scholarship fund—and she didn't vanish. She asked me to drive her to the bus station!
SECRET UNLOCKED: In Hannah's Trash folder is a photo of a torn notebook page showing CHLOE's signature on the missing scholarship transfer!
OMG you found it! Hannah made me promise to hide her until she could hand that page to the dean—she was terrified of Chloe!
10:26 PM · Suddenly, a brand-new message pops into 'LAKE HOUSE 5' from Hannah's account.
Wait... why did Hannah just share her live location from INSIDE Zoe's street?!

nodes.headline: Hannah Is Outside Your House...
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 3: The timestamp on the lake bonfire photo exposes whose car never left the pier.

nodes.text: 10:40 PM · Group Chat 'LAKE HOUSE 5'. Someone just restored a deleted file from the shared drive.
Zoe, why did you tell everyone Hannah is outside your house?! Stop freaking us out!

nodes.caption: Recovered Bonfire Photo Metadata: 11:47 PM — Chloe's headlights are still on behind the boat shed.

nodes.text: Wait... Chloe, you swore you drove home at 11:30 PM!
Liam told me to say 11:30 so nobody would ask why Hannah was crying by the dock.
Chloe, shut up! You're twisting everything—Zoe wasn't even sober that night!

nodes.transcript: [nervous, whispering] Guys... I didn't delete the rest of the cloud folder. Hannah backed up a 40-second video before her phone died.

nodes.text: Devon, don't you dare send that link to the chat!

nodes.prompt: The group chat is exploding. How do you force the truth out?

options.label: Demand Devon drop the video link now
options.player_reply_text: Post the video right now, Devon. Whoever is innocent has nothing to hide.

options.label: Check the IP log of who wiped the folder
options.player_reply_text: I pulled the Drive activity log—the folder was wiped from Liam's laptop at 2:14 AM!

nodes.text: Fine! Look at frame 12—that's Liam's varsity jacket grabbing Hannah's backpack!
VIP TWIST: The Drive audit log proves Liam deleted 14 photos AND forged Chloe's alibi text!
She was going to report the scholarship fund I co-signed with Chloe, okay?! I only tried to grab her phone!
Wait—if Hannah is outside Zoe's house right now... whose phone is pinging from the lake?

nodes.headline: The Boat Shed Secret...
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 4: A live GPS ping lights up at the abandoned boat shed—and someone is still hiding there.

nodes.text: 11:05 PM · Rain hammers the windshield as your group's tracker refreshes in real time.
Zoe, look at Find My Phone—Hannah's SIM card just turned back on at the old boat shed!

nodes.caption: Live GPS Ping: East Pier Boat Shed — battery 4%, signal moving slowly.

nodes.text: Nobody goes to the pier at 11 PM in a storm unless they're hiding evidence.
Devon, did you bury the cracked phone where I told you or not?
OH MY GOD! Liam paid Devon to hide Hannah's phone?! You both lied to the police!

nodes.transcript: [car engine roaring] Listen to me! If the cops find that phone, ALL FOUR of us go down for obstruction!

nodes.text: I didn't push her, Zoe! I swear—when I got to the shed, her shoe was already floating in the water!

nodes.prompt: Liam is racing to the pier to destroy the phone. Your move?

options.label: Tell everyone to meet at the pier now
options.player_reply_text: We're all going to the pier together—and nobody destroys anything.

options.label: Forward the GPS pin silently to Detective Park
options.player_reply_text: I just sent the live GPS pin and Liam's unsent confession to Detective Park.

nodes.text: I'm five minutes away. Don't let Liam get into the shed first!
VIP TWIST: Detective Park replies instantly: "Two patrol cars are 4 minutes from East Pier. Keep them talking."
Wait—someone just opened the boat shed door from the INSIDE!
Look at the headlights... That's Hannah's yellow raincoat!

nodes.headline: Midnight At The Pier...
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 5: Hannah steps out of the shadows—and reveals the fourth person who never spoke a word.

nodes.text: 11:48 PM · East Pier. Fog curls over the black water as three cars pull up with headlights blazing.
Hannah?! You're alive?! Wait—why is she holding a flare gun?!
She's been hiding at her aunt's cabin since Friday because she didn't know which of us tried to drown her!
I didn't push her! I grabbed her phone, slipped on the wet boards, and ran when I heard Chloe's car!
I only backed the SUV toward the dock to scare her after she threatened to hand my forged scholarship transfer to the dean.
HOLD EVERYTHING! Chloe—you tried to run her off the dock over the scholarship money?! That's why your bumper was scratched!

nodes.transcript: [Hannah's recovered voice note playing] "Chloe, stop reversing! You're going to hit me—CHLOE, THE DOCK—!" [loud splash]

nodes.text: Turn that off! It was an accident—she jumped into the water herself!

nodes.prompt: Chloe reaches for her car door to flee. What do you do?

options.label: Block her SUV with Devon's car
options.player_reply_text: Devon, pull behind her bumper—she's not leaving this pier!

options.label: Stream the voice note live to the group chat
options.player_reply_text: Too late, Chloe—the full recording is pinned in the chat and backed up!

nodes.text: Done! Her SUV is boxed in—she can't move an inch!
VIP TWIST: The pinned voice note auto-syncs to every parent and campus admin in the shared emergency group!
Blue lights on the ridge! Police are coming down the pier road!
Zoe, please... we've been best friends since freshman year!

nodes.headline: The Last Confession
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 6 (Season Finale): Sirens fill the night air—who walks away clean, and who faces justice?

nodes.text: 12:04 AM · Police cruisers surround East Pier. Hannah wraps a thermal blanket around her shoulders beside you.
Tell them it was dark, Zoe! Tell them my brakes slipped!
You left your best friend in freezing water and spent three days framing Liam and Devon.
I'm turning myself in for tampering with the cloud folder. No more lies.
Me too. I'm giving Detective Park the phone I hid in my trunk.
You're all traitors! Without my family's lawyer none of you would even—

nodes.transcript: [calm, clear] Detective Park, here is the original SIM card, the bonfire metadata, and the unsent confession screenshots.

nodes.text: Look at Chloe's face... She just realized her dad's lawyer can't erase a voice recording.

nodes.prompt: The group chat 'LAKE HOUSE 5' sits open on your screen. Choose your Finale!

options.label: Archive the chat and walk Hannah home
options.player_reply_text: This group chat is over. Come on, Hannah—let's go home.

options.label: Post the final verdict and leave the chat
options.player_reply_text: Final update: Hannah is safe. The truth is out. Nobody lies again.

nodes.text: Thanks for not giving up on her, Zoe. You were the only real friend in this chat.
VIP FINALE: Your final message locks the thread forever—and Hannah squeezes your hand with tears of relief.
I'm sorry for everything, Zoe. Take care of Hannah.
The rain finally stopped. For the first time since Friday, nobody is hiding.

nodes.headline: Act 2: The Hidden Second Group Chat...
nodes.teaser_text: Hannah is safe, yet your phone just chimed with an invite to a secret group chat created three days BEFORE the bonfire. Episode 7 begins Act 2.

nodes.text: 12:25 AM · East Pier Parking Lot. Police cruisers pull away as your phone vibrates with an archived group invite: "LAKE HOUSE 4 — NO ZOE".
Wait... why was I just added to a secret group chat created Wednesday—with Liam, Chloe, and Devon all inside?!
Zoe, swear on my life I thought that was just a surprise birthday chat for you! Look at the timestamps—someone wiped half the messages!
Hold on. One message didn’t get wiped at 11:18 PM Friday: "Grab her spare phone before she reaches the pier."
Shit, how did the backup bot re-sync that archive?!
Devon, I saw that unsent text. Who was the admin who created "LAKE HOUSE 4"?

nodes.prompt: The hidden chat archive is still open. What do you check first?

options.label: Screenshot the admin phone number right now
options.player_reply_text: Screenshotting the admin log before anyone tries to nuke this group!

options.label: Export the hidden media folder before lock
options.player_reply_text: Forget the chat log—I’m exporting the shared media folder right now!

nodes.text: That admin number isn’t any of ours—it’s a prepaid burner SIM bought at the lake gas station!
VIP TWIST: The media folder contains a photo of Hannah’s research laptop tucked inside a waterproof duffel bag!
Chill out, Zoe. I freaked out because I didn’t want the cops dragging us back to the precinct over an old prank chat.
Not a prank, Devon. I just walked back under the boathouse deck—and I found a cracked burner phone still pinging GPS.

nodes.headline: The Cracked Phone Ping
nodes.teaser_text: Next Episode: The water-damaged burner phone under the floorboards points straight to the abandoned caretaker’s cabin.

nodes.text: 1:10 AM · Boathouse Deck. Damp timber creaks under Liam’s sneakers as he wipes lake mud off the shattered screen.

nodes.caption: Look at the last GPS route on this burner—Friday 11:32 PM, straight from the bonfire to the old caretaker’s cabin across the cove!

nodes.text: Wait... Hannah told the officers she never went near the caretaker’s cabin. That means whoever owned this burner was hiding something there!
Guys, Hannah’s competition prototype USB wasn’t in her jacket when they found her! She’s been crying about it in the ambulance!

nodes.transcript: [whispering] Hold on—the burner just got a text from an unknown buyer: "Drop the drive at the cabin before midnight tomorrow or no second wire."

nodes.text: Whoa, second wire?! Someone in our friend group got paid to steal Hannah’s project and stage the whole bonfire scare?!

nodes.prompt: The burner battery is at 3%. What do you tell Liam?

options.label: Photograph the buyer’s text and bag the phone
options.player_reply_text: Snap every text on that screen and seal it in a dry bag for the officers!

options.label: Reply to the buyer pretending to be the thief
options.player_reply_text: Text back "Confirming drop—send the first receipt ref" before it dies!

nodes.text: Got every frame right before the screen died. And guess what—there’s a partial thumbprint in pine resin on the back case.
VIP TWIST: The buyer instantly replies with a bank reference number ending in #8841—paid Friday at 3:15 PM!
Wait... if one of us is the traitor, then we’re literally texting the culprit inside this group chat right now.
Devon just went offline—and now he’s calling me directly from the parking lot.

nodes.headline: Who Created The Group?
nodes.teaser_text: Next Episode: Devon calls in a panic with a confession about the spare cabin key—and a finger pointed at Liam.

nodes.text: 1:48 AM · Your Bedroom Desk. Cold rain taps the glass as Devon’s name flashes across your screen.
Zoe, don’t trust Liam! Friday night I saw him toss a brass key into the reeds right behind the lakehouse lodge!
Hold on—if you saw that Friday night, why didn’t you tell the officers or put it in the group chat?!
Because Liam’s dad owns the lakehouse! Look, the lodge back-hallway camera covers the Wi-Fi router—check if someone looped it at 11:30 PM.
I only changed the lodge Wi-Fi password so Chloe wouldn’t upload those drunk bonfire clips...

nodes.prompt: Devon blames Liam, and Liam just unsent a confession about the Wi-Fi. Who do you press?

options.label: Demand Liam hand over the lodge CCTV login
options.player_reply_text: Liam, give me the lodge camera login right now—no more hiding behind unsent texts!

options.label: Test Devon on how he knew the exact 11:30 time
options.player_reply_text: Wait a second, Devon—how did YOU know the hallway camera was looped at 11:30 PM?

nodes.text: Fine, sending the login! You’ll see I was nowhere near the hallway at 11:30 PM—I drove to the highway gas station for band-aids!
VIP TWIST: Devon stammers for five full seconds—"I... I guessed from the bonfire photos!"—then hangs up abruptly!
Zoe, I just logged into Liam’s lodge camera app with the password he sent. You need to see the 11:30 PM clip.
Send the frame now, Chloe. Let’s see who really touched that hallway.

nodes.headline: The Empty Hallway Cam
nodes.teaser_text: Next Episode: Eighteen minutes of frozen footage prove the theft of Hannah’s backpack was an inside job.

nodes.text: 2:20 AM · Group Chat "LAKE HOUSE 5". Chloe drops the exported lodge CCTV still—and the room goes dead silent.

nodes.caption: 11:30 PM to 11:48 PM Friday. Not a single moth moves past the lamp—someone spliced an 18-minute static loop over the feed!

nodes.text: Only someone who was inside the lodge at 11:30 PM needed those 18 minutes erased so they could grab Hannah’s backpack unseen!
Check my tollbooth receipt! My car crossed Exit 14 at 11:33 PM—ten miles away from the lake. I couldn’t have touched that router.
Convenient receipt, Liam. Anyone can hand their car keys to a buddy—or set a timer script before leaving!

nodes.transcript: [shaking] Stop screaming at each other! The detective just texted—they want all four of us at the station at 9:30 AM for separate statements.

nodes.prompt: Before morning statements, what do you lock down tonight?

options.label: Ask Hannah which friend knew her laptop PIN
options.player_reply_text: I’m texting Hannah right now—who else knew the passcode to her project drive?

options.label: Pull the lodge router’s MAC device log
options.player_reply_text: Liam, pull the router’s connected device list from 11:29 PM before it rolls over!

nodes.text: Hannah just replied: she only ever shared her backup PIN with Chloe... and Devon, who helped fix her charger last week!
VIP TWIST: Only ONE personal phone stayed connected to the lodge admin panel at 11:29 PM—an Android model matching Devon’s!
Get some rest, Zoe. Tomorrow morning at the station, somebody’s alibi is going to snap in half.
See you at 9:30 AM. Let’s see who really lied.

nodes.headline: The Morning Interrogation
nodes.teaser_text: Next Episode: Separate rooms at the precinct—and two wildly conflicting timelines about the 20-minute ice run.

nodes.text: 9:30 AM · Precinct Waiting Bench. Bright morning glare pours through the glass lobby as the group texts under their breath.
Just came out of Room B. I told the truth—Devon vanished from the bonfire for 20 minutes around 11:25 saying he went to "grab ice".
Are you serious, Chloe?! The ice cooler was right behind the truck! I was helping Hannah look for her inhaler!
Wait—Hannah just told me she didn’t even drop her inhaler until AFTER midnight near the pier. Why are you changing your story, Devon?
And remember that bank reference #8841 from Friday afternoon? My cousin works compliance at Campus Credit Union—he checked the public branch log.
Wait... someone in our group received a huge wire transfer Friday afternoon right before we drove to the lake?!

nodes.prompt: The officer calls your name for Room A. What do you bring inside?

options.label: Hand over the burner phone photos immediately
options.player_reply_text: I’m giving the detective every screenshot from the hidden chat and burner right now.

options.label: Ask Liam to send the Friday wire slip first
options.player_reply_text: Hold the door—Liam, send that Friday wire screenshot so I hand it over together!

nodes.text: Smart move, Zoe. Once they subpoena that prepaid SIM receipt, the cash buyer is toast.
VIP TWIST: The officer’s eyes widen at the wire memo—"Tech Prototype Consult"—matching Hannah’s exact competition title!
Fine, let them check everything. I’ve got nothing to hide—I’m heading home to sleep.
Zoe, step outside when you finish Room A. I just got the full wire receipt—and you’re going to choke when you see the amount.

nodes.headline: The Hush-Money Wire
nodes.teaser_text: Next Episode: A Friday afternoon bank transfer exposes the exact price someone accepted to betray Hannah.

nodes.text: 11:15 AM · Campus Coffee Patio. Sunlight glints off iced lattes as Liam opens the forwarded banking slip.

nodes.caption: Friday 3:15 PM · $15,000 wired from a rival lab’s shell account straight to a student checking account—two hours before our lake trip!

nodes.text: Fifteen thousand dollars?! That’s why someone staged the bonfire panic—to keep Hannah away from the lodge while they copied her drive!
Wait... Devon’s been bragging all week about paying off his overdue tuition AND buying a new motorbike on Monday!
Need to get back to the caretaker’s shed tonight before they search it...
WHOA—Devon just typed and unsent that in the wrong chat! He meant to send it to his buyer!

nodes.prompt: Devon doesn’t know you saw the unsent text. How do you play it?

options.label: Act normal and check Hannah’s cloud backups
options.player_reply_text: Don’t spook him yet—let’s check if Hannah’s phone auto-backed up audio from the boathouse!

options.label: Plant a fake tip that police cleared the cabin
options.player_reply_text: Drop a casual text saying officers already finished searching the cove—he’ll drop his guard!

nodes.text: YES! Hannah’s cloud just synced a 12-second muffled voice clip from Friday at 11:36 PM!
VIP TWIST: Devon immediately replies "Oh thank goodness, hope we can all move on now"—confirming he plans to retrieve the drive tonight!
Hannah’s mom is bringing her spare tablet over at 3 PM so we can clean up the background noise on that boathouse clip.
One clear sound on that clip and we won’t need guesses anymore.

nodes.headline: Voice Note From The Cabin
nodes.teaser_text: Next Episode: Filtering the static reveals an unmistakable ringtone chiming right beside Hannah’s stolen backpack.

nodes.text: 3:05 PM · Campus Media Lab. Afternoon sun stripes the desk as Liam filters out lake wind from Hannah’s cloud recording.

nodes.transcript: [muffled zip, then a loud custom retro-arcade ringtone] "—relax, I’ve got her drive! Once the fog rolls in, she’ll think she dropped it by the pier."

nodes.text: OH MY GOD. That 8-bit arcade ringtone—Devon has used that exact ringtone since sophomore year! And that’s HIS voice!
He stole Hannah’s scholarship drive, looped the hallway cam, and let us tear each other apart in the group chat for three days!
Wait—where is Chloe going? Your tracker dot just left campus heading back toward Lake Road!
Hannah’s spare asthma inhaler and notebook are still on the lakehouse porch! I’ll grab them before dark and be right back.

nodes.prompt: Chloe is heading back to the lakehouse alone. What do you do?

options.label: Tell her to turn back and wait for police
options.player_reply_text: Chloe, turn around NOW—Devon’s planning to go back to the cabin tonight!

options.label: Drive after Chloe with Liam immediately
options.player_reply_text: Grab your keys, Liam—we’re driving straight to the lakehouse right now!

nodes.text: Relax, it’s still daylight! I’ll be in and out in five minutes—wait, my car battery just died in the driveway!
VIP TWIST: You forward the filtered audio to the precinct detective on the road—patrol units are already moving toward Lake Road!
Storm front is rolling in early over the cove. Chloe, stay inside the locked lodge until we get there!
Too late... someone just pulled up behind the caretaker’s shed with their headlights off.

nodes.headline: The Shadow In The Corridor
nodes.teaser_text: Next Episode: Mid-Season Twist—night falls as Chloe calls in a terrified whisper from the dark lakehouse hallway.

nodes.text: 10:40 PM · Rain lashes Lake Road. Thunder shakes the pine trees as Chloe’s frantic call lights up your dashboard.

nodes.caption: Zoe, don’t speak loud—someone is walking down the back corridor toward the shed holding a lighter and a waterproof pouch!

nodes.text: Hide behind the boathouse stairs, Chloe! We’re five minutes out—can you see who it is?
Just heard that 8-bit arcade ringtone chime from his jacket pocket! It’s DEVON! He’s burning Hannah’s spare notebooks in a tin bucket!
Chloe? I saw your phone screen glow by the porch window. Come out—we just need to talk.

nodes.prompt: Devon knows Chloe is there. What do you do right now?

options.label: Blast the horn and flash the high beams
options.player_reply_text: Floor it, Liam—hit the high beams and lay on the horn right into the yard!

options.label: Call Devon in the main group so his phone rings
options.player_reply_text: Keep your screen dark, Chloe—I’m blasting Devon’s phone with the filtered audio clip!

nodes.text: Your headlights blinded him! I sprinted out the side gate—I’m running toward your car right now!
VIP TWIST: Devon freezes as his own recorded confession plays aloud from his pocket—giving Chloe the exact second she needs to escape!
Chloe’s in the backseat! She’s shaking but unhurt—and Devon just ran back toward the caretaker’s shed!
Don’t let him reach the boat dock. Lock the gate and call the officers—Act 3 ends tonight.

nodes.headline: Act 3: Trap At The Caretaker’s Shed
nodes.teaser_text: Next Episode: Act 3 begins—Devon tries one last desperate bluff in the group chat while cornered by the rain.

nodes.text: 11:15 PM · Lakehouse Driveway. Windshield wipers slap furiously as Devon’s frantic messages flood the main group chat.
You guys are insane! I only came here because someone texted me Liam hid the drive in the shed—I was trying to save it for Hannah!
Save it with a LIGHTER, Devon?! Chloe literally watched you burn Hannah’s lab notes!
Stop lying, Devon. We have the $15,000 wire slip, the 11:29 PM router log, and the boathouse recording with your 8-bit ringtone.
If I dump the waterproof pouch in the deep cove, they’ll never have physical proof...
ZOE! He’s going to sink Hannah’s drive in the lake! That’s two years of her scholarship research!

nodes.prompt: Devon is eyeing the wooden dock. How do you stall him?

options.label: Tell him the police already have the buyer’s ID
options.player_reply_text: Destroy that drive and you lose your only plea deal—officers already flagged your buyer’s account!

options.label: Upload the raw admin audio to the group now
options.player_reply_text: Chloe, drop the hidden group’s raw admin audio—let him hear himself bargaining!

nodes.text: You’re bluffing! Nobody traced that account—wait, why is my banking app locked?!
VIP TWIST: Devon drops his flashlight in shock as his own negotiation clip blasts into the group chat!
Patrol cars are eight minutes away on the highway. Keep him talking—Wait, the lodge porch lights just went pitch black!
He cut the main breaker box! I can’t see the dock anymore!

nodes.headline: The Deleted Backup
nodes.teaser_text: Next Episode: Chloe exposes the final raw audio from the hidden chat—and Devon’s mask shatters completely.

nodes.text: 11:50 PM · Pitch-black Lakehouse Yard. Only your car’s dashboard glow lights three pale faces as rain hammers the roof.

nodes.transcript: [playing recovered admin log] "Once Zoe and Chloe panic at the bonfire, I’ll grab Hannah’s prototype and split—nobody checks the caretaker’s shed."

nodes.text: Fine! Yeah, it was me! You think it’s fair Hannah gets a full ride while my family’s drowning in bills?!
Hannah offered to split her lab grant with you last semester, Devon! You didn’t do this to survive—you sold out your own friend!
Put the waterproof pouch down and walk toward the headlights, Devon. Don’t turn theft into something you can’t come back from.
Stay in the car! I’m taking the rowboat across to the south road—don’t follow me!

nodes.prompt: Devon is bolting for the wooden pier in the dark. Your move?

options.label: Share your live GPS pin directly to police
options.player_reply_text: Sending our live dock pin to the detective—they can cut off the south road too!

options.label: Remember the padlock on the rowboat chain
options.player_reply_text: Wait—Liam, didn’t your dad chain the rowboat to the east piling with a keypad lock?!

nodes.text: Detective just confirmed—two cruisers are two minutes out from the main gate!
VIP TWIST: Liam grins—"Changed the code yesterday!" Devon yanks the rusted chain in vain as distant sirens echo off the water!
I’m stepping out with the heavy flashlight to watch the pier gate—stay on the line with me, Zoe!
Be careful, Liam! He’s desperate—Wait, why are you calling instead of texting?!

nodes.headline: Blackout At The Lakehouse
nodes.teaser_text: Next Episode: Liam calls over the roaring storm as red-and-blue sirens finally pierce the lake fog.

nodes.text: 12:15 AM · East Pier Gate. Rain pours in sheets as Liam’s urgent call cuts through the static.
Zoe, I’ve got him cornered at the end of the dock! The boat’s locked—he’s holding Hannah’s waterproof pouch over the water!
Back off, Liam! One more step and this drive sinks twenty feet deep!
Police headlights just turned past the pine bend! Two cruisers are rolling straight down the gravel path!
Devon, listen to me! Look behind you—the cruisers are here. Drop the pouch on the boards and step back!

nodes.prompt: Devon’s hand trembles over the black water. What do you say?

options.label: Remind him Hannah still cares about him
options.player_reply_text: Hannah wasn’t even angry when she woke up—she just asked if you were safe. Don’t break her heart twice!

options.label: Signal police to flood the pier with lights
options.player_reply_text: Wave the patrol cruiser straight onto the dock apron—light up every inch of those boards!

nodes.text: ...I messed up so bad, Zoe. I’m setting it down on the dock.
VIP TWIST: Twin patrol spotlights lock onto the dock—Devon drops to his knees and slides the sealed pouch safely away from the edge!
I’ve got the pouch! Dry, sealed, completely intact—Hannah’s whole research drive is safe!
Officers just put Devon in the back of the cruiser. It’s finally over...

nodes.headline: Caught On The Dock
nodes.teaser_text: Next Episode: Red-and-blue lights fade over East Pier as every stolen file and hidden lie comes to light.

nodes.text: 12:42 AM · East Pier Turnaround. The rain softens to a mist as officers bag the burner phone and sealed research drive.
Just texted Hannah a photo of her drive with the detective. She sent back ten crying emojis.
The detective said Devon already gave up the name of the rival lab director who wired him the $15,000.

nodes.transcript: [softly] Zoe... Liam... I’m so sorry I panicked and deleted those bonfire photos at the start. I made everything ten times harder.

nodes.text: Hey, I left the group chat like an idiot and changed the Wi-Fi password. None of us handled Friday night like geniuses.
Tell Hannah I really am sorry...

nodes.prompt: Before the officers confiscate Devon’s phone, you see that last unsent line. Reaction?

options.label: Let the law handle him and protect your friends
options.player_reply_text: Sorry doesn’t erase three nights of terror—let’s just go home and check on Hannah.

options.label: Save a screenshot for Hannah to decide herself
options.player_reply_text: It’s not my apology to accept—I’ll show Hannah tomorrow and let her decide.

nodes.text: Agreed. Tomorrow morning we sign our final statements and put this nightmare behind us.
VIP MOMENT: Liam nods quietly—"That’s why you’ve always been the heart of this group, Zoe."
Hop in the car, guys. Heater’s on full blast and hot cocoa is on me.
First good night’s sleep since Friday. See you at the precinct at 10 AM.

nodes.headline: Clearing Every Name
nodes.teaser_text: Next Episode: Morning sunlight at the precinct as Devon signs his full confession and every false suspicion dissolves.

nodes.text: 10:20 AM · Precinct Front Steps. Clear blue sky stretches over the avenue as Zoe, Liam, and Chloe step out into the sun.
Case officially closed on our end. Devon signed his full confession, and the rival lab director was just brought in for questioning.
AND Hannah’s professor just emailed—they accepted her recovered prototype for the national finals!
Wait—really?! After everything she went through at the lake, she actually made the finals?!
She’s waiting for us at the campus café right now with a whole tray of iced coffees. Says she refuses to celebrate without you.
One thing before we walk over—should we finally archive "LAKE HOUSE 5" for good?

options.player_reply_text: Lock it in the past—let’s start a brand-new chat with zero secrets.

nodes.text: Rule number one in the new chat: zero unsent messages, ever again!
VIP MOMENT: Liam and Chloe both heart your pinned line before the old chat fades into the archive.
Race you to the campus café, Zoe—Hannah’s already waving from the patio!
Right behind you!

nodes.headline: Grand Finale: Lake House 4, Reborn

nodes.text: 4:00 PM · Campus Garden Café. Warm afternoon breeze rustles the trees as four iced coffees clink together in the sun.
Wait—check Hannah’s phone! The competition board just posted the finalist spotlight with her prototype on the front banner!
And look who got credited in her special-thanks note: "To Zoe, who never stopped looking when everyone else blinked."

nodes.transcript: [laughing warmly] Next time we plan a weekend trip, we’re picking a bright beach with full cell bars and zero creepy sheds!

nodes.text: Deal. And nobody is allowed to leave the group chat unless their battery literally hits zero.
You created the new group, Zoe. What are we naming it?

options.player_reply_text: Welcome to "NO MORE SECRETS ☀️"—only honest friends allowed.

options.label: "SUNLIT 4 — ALWAYS GOT YOUR BACK"
options.player_reply_text: Welcome to "SUNLIT 4 — ALWAYS GOT YOUR BACK"—starting fresh today!

nodes.text: Best group name we’ve ever had. Cheers to surviving senior year together!
VIP GRAND FINALE: Hannah snaps a sunlit selfie of all four of you laughing—making it the new group icon forever!
Not a single lie left in the chat. Feels good, doesn’t it?
Better than good. We’re finally all home.
